name: test-perf
title: Performance report
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Repeated startup, idle, interaction and size measurements of disposable setup copies.
description: The sandbox is not supported on native Windows yet; it refuses construction instead of starting a partial run. Runs fresh private sandbox copies serially, keeps raw samples, and compares a candidate with the baseline. Configurable limits only warn; broken measurements fail and noisy comparisons remain unverified. Turning it off removes the async in-app commands; its CLI remains available. No live setup changes, real agent launches or functional correctness claims.
